_comment: Hand-authored citation registry for the Works cited appendix. entries: MLA fields plus a hand-written 'about' line per work; the appendix assembles itself from each lesson's links (rehype-lesson-citations) and looks them up here. pending: cited URLs whose bibliographic facts are still being verified -- they render nothing until moved into entries; never promote one unchecked. The collector was widened to read every href/url attribute, not just markdown links, literal anchors and SourceQuote, so works a lesson reaches through a ReadingCard or any other component are cited now too -- 24 of them arrived at once and are parked in pending, each awaiting a person to write its fields. excluded: links that are not works (course tools, shared working documents). citations.test.ts holds all three sets honest.
